$comment: WebCoder coverage SSOT. Two surfaces: Next.js frontend (frontend/web) and Django backend (backend). Thresholds are 100 per task spec. enforcement.command entries mirror the CI gate commands in .github/workflows/frontend.yml and django.yml. Note: the 100 percent floor is enforced by the orchestrator reading this file; vitest.config.ts has no coverage.thresholds block and pytest.ini has no --cov-fail-under flag, so the raw tools exit 0 below 100 percent.

command: cd frontend/web && npm ci && npm run build && npx vitest run --coverage
cd backend && pip install -r requirements.txt && pytest --ds webcoder_api.test_settings
enforcement.description: Orchestrator agents MUST check coverage against these thresholds for both surfaces before marking any task complete or creating a PR. Commands must exit 0 and measured coverage must meet thresholds.lines/branches/functions/statements at 100.
